text:
```yaml
name: Check PR Assignee and Run Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

jobs:
  check-assignee:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install gh CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          version: latest

      - name: Check PR assignee
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          ASSIGNEES=$(gh pr view $PR_NUMBER --json assignees -q '.assignees[].login')
          echo "Assignees: $ASSIGNEES"
          if echo "$ASSIGNEES" | grep -q -w "devin"; then
            echo "PR is assigned to devin."
          else
            echo "PR must be assigned to devin. Current assignees: $ASSIGNEES"
            exit 1
          fi

  test:
    needs: check-assignee
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run type-check
        run: npm run type-check

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build
```
